label: FortiAuthenticator 300F RADIUS/TACACS+ appliance
description: 1U identity and access appliance that acts as a central RADIUS and TACACS+ AAA server for switches, wireless controllers, VPN and firewalls, backed by local, LDAP/Active Directory or certificate stores plus MFA (FortiToken) and built-in CA services. Four 1GbE RJ45 data ports and an RJ45 console port; there is no switch fabric, each port is just a host interface on the appliance.
notes: Datasheet hardware table, FAC-300F: '10/100/1000 Interfaces (Copper, RJ-45): 4', SFP interfaces 0 (the 800F/3000F add 2x SFP). QuickStart: 'Ethernet Ports 1 to 4 (RJ45) 1GE network connections' plus a Console (RJ45). Port1 is normally the management port. Management via CLI, DB9 console CLI and HTTPS.
